extension.description: Compare commits, branches, the staging area and the working tree in a compact file tree.
setting.useMergeBase: Default to comparing from the common ancestor for two commits. Choosing a comparison mode from the view menu overrides this default for that repository. Working tree and staging comparisons always remain direct.
setting.groupByFolder: Group changed files by folder. File line counts stay visible; folder totals appear on hover.
setting.includeUntracked: Include untracked files when either side is the working tree.
command.toggleDiffLayout: Branch Diff: Toggle Side-by-Side / Inline Diff
command.openFileAtLine: Branch Diff: Open Working File at This Line
command.openToSide: Branch Diff: Open to the Side
command.excludeEntry: Branch Diff: Exclude Selected Items from This Comparison
command.compareWorkingTree: Branch Diff: Show All Uncommitted Changes
